editorialPolicy: Curated official publisher links only. App eligibility, merchant acceptance, SIM plans and booking availability are not live verified.

catalogue.name: WhatsApp
catalogue.summary: Message hotels, local contacts and businesses using their published WhatsApp contact.
catalogue.accountNeeded: Phone number for registration, plus mobile data or Wi-Fi

zh.summary: 通过正式公布的联系方式与酒店、本地朋友和商家沟通。
zh.accountNeeded: 注册时需要电话号码，以及移动数据或 Wi-Fi

catalogue.name: WeChat (Weixin)
catalogue.summary: Chat with contacts who already use WeChat; Weixin Pay is a separate feature.
catalogue.purpose: Messaging and optional eligible payment features
catalogue.accountNeeded: Registered WeChat account; wallet eligibility is separate
catalogue.notes: Not all Singapore merchants accept Weixin Pay; account restrictions apply.

zh.summary: 与已使用微信的朋友联系；微信支付是另一项独立功能。
zh.purpose: 通讯及符合条件的支付功能
zh.accountNeeded: 微信账户；支付资格需另行确认

catalogue.name: Alipay
catalogue.summary: An optional wallet for eligible travellers who already have an Alipay account.
catalogue.purpose: Participating merchant payments where both wallet and merchant support it
catalogue.notes: Alipay+ acceptance is not universal wallet compatibility. Carry a backup card.

zh.summary: 适用于已经持有符合资格支付宝账户的游客。
zh.purpose: 在钱包与商户都支持的场合支付
zh.accountNeeded: 符合资格并完成验证的支付宝账户

catalogue.name: Singtel hi! Tourist SIM / eSIM
catalogue.summary: Compare Singapore visitor SIM and eSIM options, including local numbers and regional data.
catalogue.accountNeeded: Check passport/ID registration and eSIM device compatibility
catalogue.notes: Validity, voice/SMS, prices and roaming change; check the operator.

zh.summary: 比较新加坡游客 SIM/eSIM、本地号码和区域流量。
zh.accountNeeded: 按要求进行证件登记，并确认设备兼容性

catalogue.name: StarHub Tourist SIM / eSIM
catalogue.summary: Compare tourist SIM and data-only visitor eSIM services.
catalogue.purpose: Visitor connectivity, with or without a Singapore number
catalogue.accountNeeded: Passport/ID verification and unlocked eSIM-capable device if relevant
catalogue.notes: Some data-only eSIMs do not include calls, SMS or a local number.

zh.summary: 比较 StarHub 游客 SIM 卡及纯数据 eSIM。
zh.accountNeeded: 护照/证件登记及兼容且未锁网的手机

catalogue.name: M1 Tourist SIM / eSIM
catalogue.summary: Review tourist prepaid SIM and eSIM purchase, registration and collection options.
catalogue.accountNeeded: Approved identity document; compatible device for eSIM
catalogue.notes: Registration and collection depend on the chosen plan; confirm with M1.

zh.summary: 了解 M1 游客预付费 SIM/eSIM 的购买、登记和领取。
zh.accountNeeded: 有效证件，eSIM 另需设备兼容

en.title: Cards and contactless wallets
en.copy: Keep an eligible contactless card or Apple Pay / Google Wallet available; verify merchant acceptance and overseas fees.

zh.title: 备妥银行卡及非接触式支付
zh.copy: 保留可用的非接触式银行卡或 Apple Pay／Google 钱包；确认商户支持及海外手续费。

en.title: Alipay / Weixin Pay at participating merchants
en.copy: Wallet eligibility and merchant acceptance both matter. Alipay+ and SGQR logos alone do not guarantee your wallet will work.

zh.title: 在支持的商户使用支付宝／微信支付
zh.copy: 账户资格及商户支持缺一不可。Alipay+ 或 SGQR 标志不保证您的钱包能够支付。

en.title: PayNow, NETS and SGQR
en.copy: Local payment systems may need a participating Singapore bank or supported app. Do not assume visitors can instantly use PayNow.

zh.title: PayNow、NETS 及 SGQR
zh.copy: 本地支付系统可能需要新加坡参与银行账户或指定应用；游客不一定能立即使用 PayNow。

en.title: WhatsApp for hotel and local contacts
en.copy: Contact a business only through its officially published number. Calls and chats need data or Wi-Fi.

zh.title: 使用 WhatsApp 与酒店和本地联系人沟通
zh.copy: 仅通过商家正式公布的号码联系；通话及聊天需要网络。

en.title: WeChat for familiar contacts
en.copy: Keep WeChat if your party already uses it. Weixin Pay is a separate service with eligibility limits.

zh.title: 使用微信联系熟悉的朋友
zh.copy: 如同行者使用微信可继续使用；微信支付需另行符合资格。

en.title: Choose a local number or data-only eSIM
en.copy: Data-only eSIMs may not provide SMS or local calls. Compare stay length, data, hotspot, roaming and expiry.

zh.title: 选择本地号码或纯数据 eSIM
zh.copy: 纯数据 eSIM 可能不提供短信或本地通话。比较天数、流量、热点、漫游及有效期。

en.title: Check your phone before purchasing
en.copy: Confirm eSIM support, carrier unlock, installation timing and passport/ID registration requirements.

zh.title: 购买前检查手机
zh.copy: 确认 eSIM 支持、是否锁网、安装时限及护照／证件登记规定。

checklist.en: Check eSIM compatibility and carrier lock
checklist.zh: 检查 eSIM 兼容性和运营商锁定

checklist.en: Choose data plan and decide if you need a local number
checklist.zh: 选择流量套餐并确定是否需要本地号码

checklist.en: Prepare a backup card or accepted wallet
checklist.zh: 准备备用银行卡或受支持的钱包
核实住宿方官方联系方式

checklist.en: Keep arrival, ticket and booking links in one place
checklist.zh: 集中保存抵达、门票及预订链接
